population collapse caused by, among other factors, habitat destruction and climate
variation. Bumblebees are also one of the most researched bee genera, second only to
honeybees. As a result, ecologists have gained much of their insight about wild-bee
declines from bumblebees. In a 2021 paper, zoologist Guillaume Ghisbain notes that
